questions.stem: What is the story mainly about?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Repairing a chair and giving it time to dry”. Evidence: At the craft club, I set a small wooden chair on the workbench. The teacher asks me to turn it round so its back faces the window. Now the light shows a crack that I could not see before. We repair it together and leave the chair for the glue to dry. A label tells everyone to keep away from the workbench until tomorrow. Other members choose a different table and continue making their small shelves. When we return the next day, the chair is firm and ready for painting.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“Repairing a chair and giving it time to dry”。原文依据：手工社团里，我把一把小木椅放在工作台上。 老师让我把它转过去，让椅背朝窗户。 现在，光线照出一条我先前没看见的裂缝。 我们一起修补，然后放着椅子，等胶水干。 标签让大家在明天之前远离工作台。 其他成员换一张桌子，继续做小架子。 第二天回来时，椅子牢固了，可以刷漆。

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A considerate group enjoys a gentle outdoor walk”. Evidence: A new walking group meets outside our neighbourhood centre every Saturday. The members want to keep fit and enjoy spending time outdoors together. Today they choose a short route through a quiet park near the centre. “Look out!” says the leader when a child on a scooter approaches the group. Everyone steps calmly to one side and gives the child room to pass. Later, they sit on a bench and compare ideas for next week's walk. They choose another easy route so that new members can join without feeling rushed.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A considerate group enjoys a gentle outdoor walk”。原文依据：一个新步行小组每周六在社区中心外碰面。 成员们想保持健康，也喜欢一起在户外活动。 今天他们选了中心附近安静公园的一条短路线。 一个骑滑板车的孩子靠近时，领队提醒说当心。 大家平静地移到一边，让孩子通过。 之后，他们坐在长椅上，交流下周散步的想法。 他们选了另一条轻松路线，让新成员加入时也不必着急。

translation.stem: 这篇短文主要讲什么？
